images.title: Reading a number from its tokens
images.purpose: Show the tokens of 34,682 stacked under the chart columns, their digits, the number and its name.
images.composition: Five chart columns with token stacks, a digit row, the number below and its name on the last line.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Tokens are rounded rectangles with a thin dark outline and a flat fill, each with its value printed in large bold numerals: the 10,000 token is reddish purple #CC79A7, the 1,000 token green #009E73, the 100 token amber #E69F00, the 10 token blue #0072B2 and the 1 token vermilion #D55E00 (numerals white on green, blue and vermilion, dark #1F2937 on purple and amber). A place value chart of 5 equal columns about 260 px wide, left to right. Header row: TTh, Th, H, T, O in white bold letters on blue #0072B2 cells. Under each header a tall pale grey panel holds tokens in a grid 2 tokens wide, filled left to right and top to bottom: the TTh panel holds 3 tokens labelled 10,000 (2 in the first row, 1 in the second); the Th panel holds 4 tokens labelled 1,000 (2 rows of 2); the H panel holds 6 tokens labelled 100 (3 rows of 2); the T panel holds 8 tokens labelled 10 (4 rows of 2); the O panel holds 2 tokens labelled 1 (1 row of 2). 23 tokens in all. Under the panels a digit row with the digits 3, 4, 6, 8, 2 in large bold dark numerals (80 px), each centred under its column. Under the digit row, the number 34,682 in very large bold dark numerals (110 px) with the comma clear. At the bottom one line in dark sans-serif (46 px): Thirty-four thousand six hundred eighty-two.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Read the part before the comma and say thousand, then the hundreds, tens and ones.
images.description: A place value chart with 3 ten thousand tokens, 4 thousand tokens, 6 hundred tokens, 8 ten tokens and 2 one tokens, the digits 3, 4, 6, 8, 2, the number 34,682 and its name.
images.context: Concept image for Reading numbers beyond ten thousand. It shows tokens under the chart columns, as the token table of your maths book does, but uses the video's own example, 34,682, so no number printed in your maths book is given away.
images.teaching_notes: Count the tokens in each column with the students to get each digit. Then read the part before the comma, 34, and add thousand. Compare the number of tokens with the digit under them.

image_decisions.why: Tokens stacked under the chart columns turn each digit into a count and support reading the number name.
